name: Instructor Marta Voss
desc: Forties, scarred jaw, cropped grey-streaked hair, weathered Garrison cloak. Former wall-top cannoneer turned drill instructor. Blunt, tired, and quietly protective of her cadets.
personality: Blunt, dry, watchful. Hides worry behind orders. Hates paperwork and hates unanswered letters more.
voice: Short sentences. Rarely raises her voice; doesn't need to.
